items.title: Why Gucci's 'Made in China' sneakers are raising questions
items.summary: Asia-focused retail trade outlet covers Gucci's new Drip sneaker (part of Demna's Primavera collection, roughly $1,000/EUR800) now carrying 'Made in China' labels, the first break from the brand's all-Italian-made footwear tradition. Quotes a Berenberg analyst warning of tension between product provenance and the luxury positioning Gucci is trying to reclaim, and a Milan consultant's line that "Made in China is not a good look." Directly relevant to SEA's price-conscious aspirational luxury buyers weighing whether Gucci still justifies premium pricing.

items.title: Review: Demna's Gucci S/S27 'The Store Show' delivers his first complete personal vision
items.summary: Asia regional fashion outlet's runway review of Demna's SS27 'The Store Show,' praising the collection's balance of commercial appeal and signature aesthetic (oversized Horsebit hardware, layered belts, a nude dress held by a teardrop metal weight). Notes the show's front row drew SEA attention via XG's COCONA and Thai ambassadors PP Krit and Billkin, alongside Cardi B, Shawn Mendes and Donatella Versace. Concludes Demna's 'Gucci finally gets its act together' — a notably positive critical verdict worth weighing against the brand's still-declining sales.

items.title: Gucci's official channels spotlight Thai ambassadors Billkin and PP Krit from Milan show
items.summary: Thai-entertainment outlet (read heavily by the Thai fandom diaspora) reports Gucci's official accounts formally featured ambassadors Billkin and PP Krit following Milan's 'The Store Show,' pictured alongside Romeo Beckham, Carine Roitfeld and Song Weilong. Framed locally as a milestone of international recognition for the two Thai stars, sustaining SEA fandom engagement into October.

items.title: Thai fan post celebrating Billkin and PP Krit as the 'Gucci BA couple' in Milan
items.summary: Thai-language fan post ("the Gucci brand ambassador couple from Thailand") celebrating Billkin and PP Krit appearing together at Milan's SS27 Store Show, using hashtags #GUCCISS27xPPKRIT and #GUCCISS27xBILLKIN. Represents organic SEA fandom SNS volume distinct from brand-issued content; exact like/repost counts not visible via available access (X post pages returned a paywall/402 on direct fetch), so engagement fields are recorded as null rather than estimated.

items.title: Weibo discussion thread on Billkin and PP Krit's Gucci ambassador status after Milan
items.summary: Chinese-language Weibo commentary cluster discussing the Thai pair's Milan appearance and asking whether their Gucci ambassador status has been validated by international fashion media (Vogue, WWD). Cross-border SEA-to-China fandom chatter; indicates the story traveled beyond Thai-language channels. No visible like/repost/view counters captured from the search snippet, so engagement recorded as null.

items.title: PurseForum thread on Demna's debut Gucci collection and 'The Tiger' film continues
items.summary: Ongoing PurseForum community discussion (global/US-based membership, but relevant as a cross-regional opinion thermometer for SEA members active on the forum) debating Demna's design direction, bag construction quality, and whether the aesthetic shift signals genuine reinvention or dilution of house codes. Represents organic community sentiment outside brand or SEA-local media channels; direct page fetch previously blocked by bot protection so content inferred from indexed snippets.

items.title: PP Krit takes bedazzling to the next level on the Gucci front row
items.summary: Niche fashion/style outlet profiles Thai ambassador PP Krit's fully rhinestone-covered Y2K-inspired outfit (crop top, straight-leg pants, fur coat) worn to Gucci's SS27 Store Show front row, part of the broader wave of SEA celebrity coverage around the Milan show. Smaller outlet, included as supporting evidence of continued regional media volume rather than as a primary signal.

items.title: Thousands of pre-loved Gucci bags listed on Carousell Singapore, continued high secondhand supply
items.summary: Observation of Singapore's dominant consumer resale marketplace shows several thousand active Gucci bag listings (GG Marmont among the most common), with the platform's authentication/refund guarantee cited as the main trust mechanism against counterfeits. High and sustained resale-market supply is a soft proxy for softening primary-market demand/ownership turnover in SEA, relevant to the critical-angle (resale market chatter) brief; no brand-side data exists to confirm causation, so treated as directional community signal only.
